depictions.name: Isla Providencia
depictions.text: Isla de Providencia Isla Providencia (English: Providence Island) is an island located in the West Indies, southwest of Jamaica. It was once a Mayan settlement, but was eventually abandoned, with the islanders leaving a massive temple complex behind.
